Cut 16 rounds of pastry with a 6cm cutter, then cut a smaller circle half way through each.Brush with egg and bake 15 minutes until puffed. Push the centres down while warm.Cook the mushrooms, garlic and thyme leaves in the butter for 8 minutes until the liquid is gone.Stir in the flour, then the cream, and simmer 2 minutes until thick. Season.Spoon into the cases and finish with chopped parsley.MainsStuffed turkey breast roastTurkey breast rolled around sage and onion sourdough stuffing, roastedHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast1 at 180°C with the potatoes around it, rubbed with oil.Rest the turkey.Cook the sprouts and toss with the sprout butter.Hogwarts Express Cornish pastiesThe trolley on the Hogwarts ExpressHow to make
